blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: In the global attention layers of Gemma 4 31B, the value is the normalized key projection, and the key is the value scaled by a fixed weight, with rotary position encoding on one quarter of its dimensions. The Gemma 4 report states that this design reduces the global KV cache by up to 37.5%, but the open serving engines that we checked still store a full key and a full value: 1,024 values per KV head and token. We store one 640-value row instead, exact in real arithmetic, and an unchanged paged attention kernel reads it through two overlapping strided views as its key cache and its value cache. In a vLLM prototype with the 16-bit 31B model, the outputs are bit-identical to an emulation of the same arithmetic on the stock cache, 2 of 432 final answers differ from the stock engine (within its run-to-run noise), and the steady decode KV memory per request falls by a factor of 1.34 to 1.40 at 32K to 64K tokens. On a prefill/decode pair of two A100 GPUs with NIXL transfer and CPU offload, a decode engine with a full 15 GiB pool ran 1.38 times the stock decode tokens per step for 16K-token prompts (repeated to 0.06%) and 1.24 times for 8K-token prompts; a model of the vLLM block pool predicted both ratios to within 1% (the engine was 0.7% to 0.9% higher) and matched the change between them. The eager decode throughput rose by 1.30 and 1.11 times, and on this path the compact engine gave the same output tokens as the emulation for 8 prompts at batch 1. The run-time prototype makes an eager step 4% to 9% slower at equal batch, and the method does not yet stack with an 8-bit KV cache at the default scale.

Gemma 4的报告指出,这种设计将全球KV缓存减少高达37.5%,但是我们所检查的开放服务引擎仍然存储着一个完整的密钥和一个完整的值:每KV头和令牌有1,024个值. 我们存储了一个640个值行, 准确的在真实的算术中, 一个不变的页式关注内核读取它 通过两个相重叠的相接的视图 作为它的密钥缓存和其值缓存。 在16位31B型的vLLM原型中,输出与股票缓存上同一算术的仿真相同,432个最终答案中有2个与股票引擎不同(在其运行到运行的噪声范围内),每个请求的稳定解码KV内存相差1.34到1.40的系数以32K到64K的令牌相差. 在两个有NIXL转接和CPU卸载的A100GPU的预装/解码对接上,一个装有全15个GiB池的解码引擎每步运行了1K-token poils的1.38倍(重复到0.06%)和1.24倍(重复到8K-token poils);一个vLLM块池的模型预测了两者的比例都在1%以内(引擎高了0.7%到0.9%)并匹配它们之间的变化. 急切地解码吞吐量上升了1.30和1.11倍,在此路径上,紧凑的引擎给出了与第1批8个出道的模拟输出符相同的输出符. 运行时原型使得在等分批时的急切步骤4%到9%的速度更慢,而该方法尚未以默认比例堆放出8位KV缓存.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: The KV cache sets the number of long requests that one GPU can serve. Paged serving engines such as vLLM [ 1 ] keep the cache in fixed-size blocks and admit a request only when its blocks fit in the pool. A smaller cache per request therefore allows a larger batch and more decode tokens per second, until the GPU becomes compute bound.
blocks.zh: KV缓存设置了一个GPU可以服务的长期请求的数量. 页面服务引擎如vLLM [1] 将缓存保留在固定大小的块中,只有当其块适合池中时才允许请求. 因此,每个请求一个较小的缓存允许每秒一个更大的批次和更多的解码符,直到GPU成为计算约束.

blocks.en: Gemma 4 [ 2 ] uses two layer types. In the 31B model, 50 sliding-window layers attend to the last 1,024 tokens with 16 KV heads of 256 dimensions, and 10 global layers attend to the whole context with 4 KV heads of 512 dimensions. At long context the global layers hold most of the cache of a request. They also have a special structure, which the model configuration calls attention_k_eq_v : they have no value projection. The value is the RMS-normalized key projection, and the key is that value multiplied by the key-norm weight, with rotary position encoding (RoPE) [ 3 ] on 128 of the 512 dimensions. The Gemma 4 report states that this design reduces the global KV cache by up to 37.5% [ 2 ] . The 26B-A4B and 12B models use the same design; the E2B and E4B models do not.
blocks.zh: Gemma 4 [2]使用两个层型. 在31B模型中,50个滑窗层处理最后的1,024个令牌,上面有256维的16个KV头,10个全局层处理整个上下文,上面有512维的4个KV头. 从长远来看,全球层占据了请求的大部分缓存。 它们也有特殊的结构,模型配置要求注意_k_eq_v: 它们没有价值预测。 值是 RMS 常态化的密钥投影,键是该值乘以密钥-规范重,在512维的128上,旋转位置编码(ROPE)[3]. Gemma 4的报告指出,这种设计将全球KV缓存减少37.5%[2]. 26B-A4B型和12B型采用相同的设计;E2B型和E4B型不采用.

blocks.en: The open serving engines that we checked do not realize this saving: they store 1,024 values per KV head and token in these layers (Section 7 ). This paper shows how to store 640 values that an unchanged paged attention kernel can read, and it measures what this gives in vLLM. The kernel reads the 640-value row through two views: a view is a window on the same memory with its own shape and strides, so no data is copied (Figure 1 ).

blocks.en: We do not claim the saving, the shape of the stored row or the exact cache reduction as new. The Gemma 4 report states the saving. Multi-head latent attention (MLA) [ 4 ] caches a shared part plus a separate RoPE part, and its decode kernels read the key and the value from one cached row [ 5 ] . Slim attention [ 6 ] caches only the keys of multi-head attention layers and computes the values from them with a matrix product. Our two-view read is the MLA decode layout specialized to equal key and value widths, so that kernels that require equal key and value head sizes read the shared buffer unchanged; our searches targeted Gemma 4 and its engines, not this layout in general. Our contributions are: 1. A compact row and a two-view read. One row of 640 values per KV head and token holds the rotated part of the key and the whole value. A stock paged attention kernel reads it through two overlapping strided views; the key-norm weight folds into the query, and a fixed permutation restores the output order. The method is exact in real arithmetic (Section 3 ). 2. A checked vLLM prototype. Its outputs are bit-identical to an emulation of the same arithmetic on the stock cache, and its final answers stay within noise of the stock engine (Sections 4 and 5.1 ). 3. Measurements and a speed bound. We measure the memory per request, the batch that a fixed pool holds and the step cost of the prototype. A byte count shows why the smaller cache gives little speed per step at these batch sizes: the weights are about 85% of the bytes that a decode step reads (Sections 5.2 to 5.4 ). 4. A test in a serving decode node. The compact cache works with the vLLM CPU offload connector and, with a small patch for the pinned build, with NIXL transfer from a prefill engine. On a two-GPU prefill/decode pair whose decode pool stays full, the compact decode engine ran 1.38 and 1.24 times the stock decode tokens per step at two operating points. A model of the block pool, frozen before each run, predicted both ratios to within 1% (the engine was 0.7% to 0.9% higher) and matched the change between them. The eager decode throughput rose by 1.30 and 1.11 times, and the compact engine gave the same output tokens as the emulation for 8 prompts at batch 1 (Section 6 ).

blocks.en: vLLM [ 1 ] keeps the KV cache in a fixed pool of GPU memory, which it splits into blocks of B B tokens; a block holds one page in each layer of a group. For a hybrid model, the vLLM version that we used [ 8 ] splits the layers into groups of equal size; for Gemma 4 31B these are 5 sliding groups and 1 global group, with 10 layers each. All groups must use one page size in bytes. The code that enforces this, which we call the page unifier, grows the block size of a group whose page divides the largest page, and otherwise pads the smaller page. The scheduler admits a waiting request, that is, starts its prefill, only if its blocks fit: at this commit the option scheduler_reserve_full_isl (ISL: input sequence length) is on by default, so the full prefill reservation must fit in the free blocks. If a running request needs a block and none is free, the engine preempts a request: it stops that request and computes it again later. The Triton [ 9 ] attention backend of vLLM takes the key cache and the value cache as two tensors with explicit strides, and it writes new keys and values with a separate cache-write kernel.
blocks.zh: vLLM [1] 将 KV 缓存保存在一个固定的 GPU 内存池中, 它会分裂成 B 符号的块; 一个块在一个组的每层各有一个页面. 对于一个混合模型,我们使用的vLLM版本将各层分成等大小的组;对于Gemma 4 31B,这些是5个滑动组和1个全球组,各有10层. 所有组必须在字节中使用一个页面大小 。 执行这个的代码,我们称之为页面统一器,它会扩大一个页面分割最大页面的组的块大小,否则会将较小的页面贴上. 调度员接受一个等待请求,即只有当其块适合时,才开始其预填:在此输入选项调度器_reserve_ful_isl(ISL:输入序列长度)是默认的,所以完整的预填保留必须适合自由块. 如果运行中的请求需要块而无块是免费的,引擎会先发制人请求:它会停止该请求,并在稍后再次计算. vLLM 的 Triton [9] 注意后端将密钥缓存和值缓存作为两个有明确步态的对称器,它用单独的缓存-写内核写出新的密钥和值.

blocks.en: In eager mode, the engine launches each GPU kernel of a decode step from Python, so many small kernels cost CPU time. With CUDA graphs, it records the kernels of a decode step once and replays them with one launch.

blocks.en: 4 Implementation in vLLM
blocks.zh: 4 执行vLLM

blocks.en: We built the prototype on vLLM 0.33.0rc1.dev229+g3966924d5 with its Triton attention backend. The vLLM log states that it forces this backend for Gemma 4 on the A100, because the two layer types have different head sizes and FlashAttention-4 is not available there. The prototype has three parts, installed as patches before the engine starts: 1. The KV specification. The global layers report 640 values per head and token and a block of 48 tokens. The stock allocator, page unifier and scheduler then plan and manage the pool with no other change. 2. The V view. The Triton backend splits a cache row at the head size, so a 640-value row gives a correct K view and a value cache of only 128 values. Small wrappers of the attention and cache-write entry points replace that value cache with the V view (a strided view, no copy). 3. The transforms. Module hooks on the 10 global attention layers form the folded and permuted query of Eq. ( 3 ) after RoPE, form the two write operands and permute the output back. The attention kernels are unchanged: we changed no kernel source code, and the wrappers and hooks change only Python calls. The run-time transforms launch about 110 small kernels per decode step of the 10 global layers. Because the weights are fixed, a production version could fold w 𝒰 w_{\mathcal{U}} into the query-norm weight and the output permutation into the input columns of W o W_{o} at load time, which removes most of these kernels. These folds change the rounding or the order of the sums, so they need their own output check, which we did not run. The query permutation must follow RoPE, because RoPE pairs dimension i i with dimension i + 256 i+256 . So either the permutation stays a run-time gather, or the RoPE operation takes a permuted index map.

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5. 评价

blocks.en: The engine runs of this section used one A100 SXM 80GB (Section 6 uses two GPUs), vLLM 0.33.0rc1.dev229+g3966924d5, Triton 3.8.0 and the 16-bit google/gemma-4-31B-it checkpoint, with a 16-bit KV cache, no prefix caching and at most 2,048 batched tokens per step. The build, capacity and step-time runs used a fixed KV pool of 15 GiB (6,144 blocks) and at most 16 sequences; the 16-bit weights (62.6 GB) leave about this much of the GPU memory for the cache. The engine ran in eager mode unless we say otherwise. Appendix F gives all settings.
blocks.zh: 本节的发动机运行使用一个A100 SXM 80GB(第6节使用两个GPU),vLLM 0.33.0rc1.dev229+g3966924d5,Triton 3.8.0和16位google/gemma-4-31B-it检查点,有一个16位的KV缓存,没有前缀钉,每步最多有2,048批的标志. 积分,容量和步骤时间运行使用一个15 GiB(6,144块)和最多16个序列的固定KV池;16位重(62.6 GB)大约为缓存留下了这么多GPU内存. 引擎在急速运行 除非我们另有说法 附 录 F给出所有设置.

blocks.en: We call each configuration that we compare an arm . STOCK is the unmodified engine and cache. COMPACT is the prototype with the 640-value row. EMULV is the stock cache with the same query and output transforms as COMPACT: it computes the same arithmetic on the stock cache, so a difference between COMPACT and EMULV can come only from the cache layout. The accuracy study also has a noise arm, which adds one extra 16-bit rounding of the query to show how large a harmless rounding change looks, and a positive control, the stock 8-bit cache at a KV scale of 1.0, which we expected to change more answers.
blocks.zh: 我们调用每个组合 我们比较一个手臂。 STOCK是未修改的引擎和缓存. COMPACT是640值行的原型. EMULV是存储缓存,其查询和输出变换与COMPACT相同:它在存储缓存上计算出相同的算术,因此COMPACT和EMULV之间的区别只能来自缓存布局. 精度研究还有一个噪声臂,它增加了一个额外的16位的四舍五入的查询,以显示无害的四舍五入变化的外观,以及一个正控,即KV比例为1.0的股票8位缓存,我们预计会改变更多的答案.

blocks.en: For each experiment we recorded the question and a pass-or-fail rule before the run, and we changed a rule only before the data of the run that it governs. We call a run invalid if a validity check that we set before the run failed. This does not mean that its numbers are wrong, but we use them only as exploratory results (Appendix A ).

blocks.en: 5.1 Exactness and accuracy
blocks.zh: 5.1 准确性和准确性

blocks.en: COMPACT and EMULV gave bit-identical outputs for all 432 prompts below and for all 1,264 recorded arrays of prompt log-probabilities. So, on these prompts and in eager mode, the two-view read and the page plan add no error to the arithmetic of the transforms.
blocks.zh: COMPACT和EMULV为下面所有432个提示和所有1 264个记录的迅速日志概率阵列提供了位同输出。 因此,在这些提示和急切模式上,双视图读取和页面计划不会给变换的算术增加任何错误.

blocks.en: We measured the accuracy on 432 items: 400 GSM8K test problems [ 11 ] and 32 needle-retrieval prompts of 7.7K tokens, in chat format with greedy decoding. Every arm answered all 32 needle prompts correctly, so every change came from the GSM8K items. In the build run, COMPACT had an accuracy of 0.9769 and STOCK 0.9722 (422 and 420 of 432): a change of + 0.46 +0.46 points, with the 95% Agresti–Min interval for paired answers [ − 0.32 , + 1.24 ] [-0.32,+1.24] , inside our preset margin of ± 3 \pm 3 points (we count a change inside this margin as no loss). Two final answers changed, both toward the correct answer, and the generated text differed in 88 of the 432 items (20.4%). The mean negative log-likelihood that the model gives to the GSM8K reference solutions changed by + 0.00004 +0.00004 nats per token (interval [ − 0.0007 , + 0.0008 ] [-0.0007,+0.0008] ). The stock engine alone scored 0.9769 in an earlier run with other settings (the batch cap, the KV pool and the maximum model length), so a change of 2 items has no stable sign.

The GSM8K sequences are short (about 240 tokens with the answer), and only the 32 needle prompts reach 7.7K tokens, so no accuracy test reaches the lengths at which the saving matters. The base accuracy is near the ceiling, and the positive control did not separate from the compact arm. So the result is “no break found”, not a proof of equal quality.

blocks.en: The steady decode footprint , the steady decode KV memory of one request, is the number of blocks in use while that request decodes. The prefill peak is the largest number of blocks in use while the engine prefills one request; it sets the cost of admission. The steady decode footprint fell from 1,349 to 1,008 blocks at 32K tokens and from 2,373 to 1,690 blocks at 64K tokens (Figure 2 , Table 1 ): factors of 1.338 and 1.404, or 0.83 and 1.67 GiB less KV per request. These ratios count all layers and match the page-plan arithmetic to within one block: the sliding blocks do not change, and the global blocks fall by a factor of 1.5. So the saving is a factor of 1.6 in the global-layer values, 1.5 after the page padding, and 1.34 to 1.40 over all layers.
blocks.zh: 稳定的解码脚印,一个请求的稳定解码 KV 内存,是请求解码时使用的块数. 预填峰值是使用中的最大块数,而引擎预填一个请求;它设定了录取成本. 稳定的解码脚印从1,349块降至1,008块,以32K令牌计算;以64K令牌计算,从2,373块降至1,690块(图2,表1):因数为1.338和1.404,或每请求0.83和1.67吉B减去KV。 这些比率计算出所有各层,并将页图算术与一个区块内:滑动区块不变,全球区块下降1.5倍。 因此,储蓄是全局值的1.6倍系数,在页贴后为1.5倍,在所有层上为1.34至1.40倍.

blocks.en: The saving at admission is smaller, because the prefill reservation includes up to 321 blocks in each sliding group in both layouts: the prefill peaks fell by factors of 1.15 and 1.23. At 32K tokens, the 15 GiB pool decoded 4 compact requests where 3 stock requests fit, and the decode rate rose from 56.0 to 69.7 tokens per second (1.24 times). At 64K tokens both layouts held 2 requests, and the compact build was 4% slower; the third compact request lacked 181 blocks (about 0.44 GiB), so a slightly larger pool would probably hold 3. The gain is a decode-state saving that becomes throughput where one more request fits, and it depends on where the pool limit falls. By its preset rule (Appendix A ), this run passed on outputs, accuracy and capacity, but not on throughput (a gain at one length only) or step cost (above the 5% limit).
blocks.zh: 录取时的节省较小,因为预填预留在两种布局的每个滑动组中包括最多321个块:预填峰降系数为1.15和1.23. 在32K令牌上,15个GiB池解码了3个股票要求合适的4个紧凑请求,解码率从56.0升至69.7个每秒(1.24倍). 在64K令牌上,两种布局都持有2项请求,而紧凑建筑速度慢了4%;第三块紧凑请求缺少181块(约0.44 GiB),所以一个稍大一点的池子可能持有3块. 增益是一种解码状态保存,在另一个请求适合的地方成为吞吐量,它取决于池限落到哪里. 根据其预设规则(Appendix A ),这次运行传递的是产出,准确度和能力,而不是吞吐量(仅一个长度的增益)或步骤成本(高于5%的限制).

blocks.en: 5.3 Step time
blocks.zh: 5.3 联合国 步骤时间

blocks.en: In eager mode, the mean decode step of the prototype was 8.7% slower than the stock step at the same batch at 32K tokens and 4.3% slower at 64K. At 32K, the transforms cost 4.8% (EMULV against STOCK), and the compact cache cost another 3.7% (COMPACT against EMULV), measured in two engine processes. A benchmark of the global layers without weights found that the compact read was faster than the stock read, and that the transforms cost mostly CPU launch time; it explains about 40% of the engine cost. The cause of the remaining cost is not known.
blocks.zh: 在急切模式中,原型机的中间解码步骤比同批量的库存步骤慢8.7%,慢4.3%,慢64K. 在32K时,变速器成本为4.8%(EMULV对STOCK),而紧凑缓存成本为3.7%(COMPACT对EMULV),用两个引擎流程测量. 一个没有权重的全球层的基准发现,紧凑读取的速度比库存读取的速度快,变换成本大多是CPU的发射时间;它解释了大约40%的发动机成本. 其余费用的原因不详。

blocks.en: In an exploratory run with full decode CUDA graphs (the FULL_DECODE_ONLY mode of vLLM, without torch.compile ), the compact step took 50.52 ms against 50.73 ms for the stock step at 3 requests of 32K tokens ( − 0.41 % -0.41\% , inside our 2% noise band). A kernel profile agrees: the compact cache cut the attention kernel time by 0.49 ms per step, and the 110 transform kernels added 0.46 ms. The output check of this run failed for 1 of 3 prompts, probably because of a schedule difference outside the timing windows, so the run is invalid by its own rule. With full decode CUDA graphs we saw no step cost above about 2%; we do not claim zero cost. Appendix C gives the details.

blocks.en: 5.4 A bound on the speed gain
blocks.zh: 5.4 国家 速度增益的束缚

blocks.en: A 37.5% smaller global cache moves fewer bytes per decode step, so one could expect a faster step. At 3 requests of 32K tokens, one decode step reads about 62 GB (decimal gigabytes) of 16-bit weights and about 10.6 GB of KV (per request: 2.68 GB in the global layers and 0.84 GB in the sliding layers). The compact cache removes about 2.7 GB of these 73 GB, or 3.7%. So even a step whose time followed its bytes would gain only about 4% here. The profile of the exploratory graph run agrees: the matrix products took 37.4 ms and attention 10.7 ms of the 50.7 ms graph step, and the compact cache cut the attention time by 0.49 ms. At larger batches the KV share of the bytes grows, but in our kernel tests the attention time followed the DRAM bytes only weakly: on an A100 the compact read saved 2.7% to 9.7% of the read time, and on an H100 the FP8 kernels had a time elasticity of 0.16 to 0.24 to the bytes (exploratory; Appendix D ). So the speed of one step does not change much; a gain in throughput must come from more requests in each step, which the next section measures.
blocks.zh: 一个37.5%的较小的全球缓存每个解码步骤移动的字节更少,所以人们可以期望一个更快的步. 在3个32K令牌的请求中,一个解码步骤读取了大约62GB(十进制千兆字节)的16位重和大约10.6GB的KV(每请求:全球层2.68GB和滑动层0.84GB). 紧凑缓存移除了这73GB中的约2.7GB,即3.7%. 因此,即使一步的时间跟随它的字节,在这里也只得到大约4%的收益。 探索图运行的剖面图表示同意:矩阵产品在50.7 ms的图步中耗时37.4 ms,注意力10.7 ms,紧凑缓存将注意力时间缩短0.49 ms. 在较大的批量中,字节的KV份额会增长,但在我们的内核测试中,注意力时间跟随DRAM字节的只有弱:在A100上,紧凑的读数节省了2.7%到9.7%的读数,在H100上,FP8内核的时间弹性为0.16到0.24到字节(探索;附录D). 因此一个步骤的速度并没有太大变化;通过量的增加必须来自每个步骤中更多的请求,接下来的一节对此进行衡量.

blocks.en: 6 Capacity in a serving decode node
blocks.zh: 6 服务解码节点的能力

blocks.en: Section 5 measured fixed batches in one engine. Large deployments often split the work: a prefill engine computes the prompt, the KV cache moves to a decode engine, and the decode engine generates the output [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] . The decode engine of such a system holds many running requests, and its KV pool is full most of the time. When the pool is full, vLLM preempts a request; with a CPU offload connector, the request can later reload its blocks from host memory instead of computing them again. This section asks whether the compact cache works on this path, and whether its capacity gain matches a model of the block pool, with a decision rule that we froze before each run.
blocks.zh: 第5节在一个发动机中测量了固定批次。 大型部署经常将工作分开:一个预填充引擎计算出提示,KV缓存移动到解码引擎,解码引擎生成输出[12,13,14]. 这种系统的解码引擎持有许多运行请求,其KV池大部分时间都是满载的. 当池满时,vLLM会先发制人请求;使用CPU卸载连接器,该请求日后可以从主机内存中重新装入其块,而不是再次计算它们. 本节询问紧凑缓存是否在这个路径上工作,其容量增益是否匹配块池的模型,以及我们在每次运行前冻结的决定规则.

blocks.en: 6.1 A model of the block pool
blocks.zh: 6.1 国家 块池的模型

blocks.en: We wrote a discrete-step model of the vLLM block pool for a decode engine. It follows the rules of the engine that we read in the source: the admission of a request only when its blocks for the full input fit, a token budget of 2,048 per step with two batches in flight (asynchronous scheduling), the preemption of the most recently admitted request when the pool is full, and a CPU tier that stores the blocks of all running requests (Appendix E ). The input is a stream of requests with lognormal prompt and output lengths (log-scale standard deviation 0.6). The engine keeps a backlog of requests that wait for blocks, so the pool is the limit. A work step is a step in which the scheduler schedules work; steps that only wait for a KV transfer do not count. The main statistic is R step = decode tokens per work step, compact decode tokens per work step, stock , R_{\text{step}}=\frac{\text{decode tokens per work step, compact}}{\text{decode tokens per work step, stock}}\,, (5) which counts how many more requests decode in each step and does not depend on the step time. The model gives R step R_{\text{step}} for the exact request sequence that the engine runs (one random seed) and a range over seeds 0 to 4 and backlog depths 2, 3 and 8. As a report only, it also gives a throughput ratio with step times from attention read times that we measured on an A100 SXM (exploratory), for CUDA graphs and with the measured costs of eager mode added.

blocks.en: 6.2 The connectors
blocks.zh: 6.2 (中文(简体) ). 连接器

blocks.en: With the stock vLLM offload connector set to store all blocks, forced preemptions of compact requests on the 31B model reloaded their generated tokens from the CPU tier, and 24 checked reloads matched byte for byte, except blocks that vLLM had computed again. The NIXL connector [ 15 ] of the pinned vLLM build could not register the compact cache, and a byte view of each padded page removes the problem. By our reading of the code, vLLM main later fixed this check in general [ 16 ] , so our patch is likely only a back-port; we did not run vLLM main. With the 12B model, NIXL moved 8 long prompts to a decode engine with all blocks intact, and NIXL-fed compact requests also reloaded correctly. Appendix E gives the details.
blocks.zh: 随着库存 vLLM 卸载连接器设置以存储所有块,31B型机上强制预置紧凑请求从CPU级重新装入其生成的代号,24个检查的重装字节匹配字节,但vLLM再次计算的块除外. 被绑定的 vLLM 构建的 NIXL 连接器 [15] 无法注册压缩缓存,每个加页的字节视图都会消除问题. 通过我们对代码的读取,vLLM主机后来将这个检查在一般 [16] 中固定下来,因此我们的补丁可能只是一个后端端口;我们没有运行vLLM主机. 有了12B型,NIXL将8个长的提示器移动到一个所有块完好无损的解码引擎上,NIXL-fed紧凑请求也正确重新加载. 附 录 E给出细节.

blocks.en: 6.3 Setup
blocks.zh: 6.3 设置

blocks.en: One container had two A100-SXM4-80GB GPUs: the prefill engine on one GPU and the decode engine, with NIXL and a 64 GiB CPU tier, on the other. Both engines ran the 16-bit 31B model in eager mode with no prefix caching; the decode engine used the 15 GiB pool of Section 5 and at most 16 sequences (Appendix F ). A driver kept two prefilled requests ready and three requests waiting on the decode engine, so the decode pool stayed full: the decode engine had a waiting request in at least 99.6% of the work steps of every run. The prompts were random token ids, each request decoded its drawn output length ( ignore_eos ), and decoding was greedy. Each arm measured the work steps 2,000 to 22,000. The stock arm ran the stock cache without the transforms; the compact arm ran the compact cache with them. We tested two operating points that differ in prompt length: D3H (median prompt 16,384 tokens) and D3Q (median prompt 8,192 tokens), both with a median output of 2,048 tokens. The model predicts a clearly smaller gain for the shorter prompts. We expected this: the sliding layers keep a fixed size, so the footprint ratio of Section 5.2 falls with the prompt length.
blocks.zh: 一个容器有两个A100-SXM4-80GB GPU:一个GPU上的预充引擎和解码引擎,另一个是NIXL和一个64 GiB CPU级. 这两款引擎都以急切模式运行16位31B型号,没有前缀卡座;解码引擎使用了第5节的15GiB池,最多16个序列(Appendix F. 一个司机在解码引擎上保持两个预填请求准备就绪,三个请求等待,因此解码池保持了满载:解码引擎在每跑至少99.6%的工作步骤中有一个等待请求. 提示是随机的符号代号,每个请求解码其绘制的输出长度(忽略_eos),解码很贪婪. 每个臂部测量了2 000至22 000步。 库存臂在没有变换的情况下运行库存缓存;紧凑臂与它们一起运行紧凑缓存. 我们测试了两个快速长度不同的操作点:D3H(中导16,384个令牌)和D3Q(中导8,192个令牌),两者的中位输出为2,048个令牌. 该模型预测,对于较短的提示来说,收益明显较小. 我们预料到的是:滑动层保持固定的大小,因此第5.2节的足迹比例随即下降.

blocks.en: Table 2 and Figure 3 give the results. At D3H the compact decode engine ran 1.376 times the stock decode tokens per work step; the model predicted 1.364 for the same request sequence. The two stock runs agreed to 0.03%, and a second compact run (the repeat run ), in another session on another host, repeated the compact value to 0.06%. At D3Q the ratio was 1.237, against 1.229 in the model. Both values are inside their frozen bands, but only because the bands were widened by 1%. The engine was 0.9% (D3H) and 0.7% (D3Q) above the top of the model range. The engine ran the request sequence of seed 0, which is at the top of that range at both points. Other seeds give ratios up to 4% to 5% lower, so the frozen rule would also have passed a model that overstated the gain by that much.

blocks.en: The ratio fell by 0.139 from D3H to D3Q, and the model predicted a fall of 0.135. So the measured fall was 1.03 times the predicted one, inside the frozen limits of 0.75 to 1.25. This result does not depend on which D3H run we use: the limits hold for any D3H value from 1.338 to 1.406. The test confirms the direction and the size of the fall, not an accuracy of 1%.
blocks.zh: 该比例从D3H下降至D3Q下降0.139,模型预测跌幅为0.135. 因此测得的跌幅是预测的1.03倍,在0.75到1.25的冻结限值之内. 这个结果并不取决于我们使用的D3H运行:任何D3H值的限值从1.338到1.406. 测试确认掉落的方向和大小,不准确度为1%.

blocks.en: The model does not predict each arm exactly: at D3H the compact engine was 0.95% above it, and at D3Q the stock engine was 0.6% below it, while the other arm matched (Table 2 ). So the error of the model is not a constant bias of one layout (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 模型并不准确预测每个臂:在D3H时,紧凑的发动机比它高出0.95%,在D3Q时,库存发动机比它低0.6%,而另一臂则匹配(表2). 因此模型的错误并不是一个布局的恒定偏差(Appendix E ).

blocks.en: The eager decode throughput rose by a factor of 1.30 at D3H and 1.11 at D3Q. In these runs a compact step took 5.5% (D3H) and 11% (D3Q) longer than a stock step, but it also held more requests. Both values lie inside the range that the model gives with CUDA-graph step costs, and the D3Q value also inside the eager range. These are single runs: the two stock runs at D3H differed by 2.7% in throughput, so we do not resolve differences smaller than about 3%. Compared with Section 5.2 , where a fixed batch gained only where one more request fitted, a stream of requests of mixed lengths turns the smaller footprint into a steady gain.
blocks.zh: 急切的解码吞吐量在D3H和D3Q分别上升了1.30倍和1.11倍. 在这些赛程中,一个紧凑的台阶比一个股票台阶长5.5%(D3H)和11%(D3Q),但也持有更多的请求. 这两个值都位于模型给出的带有CUDA-graph步骤成本的范围之内,D3Q值也在急切范围内. 它们是单次运行:D3H的两股运行量在吞吐量上相差2.7%,因此我们不会解决小于3%的分歧. 与第5.2节相比,固定批次只有在又符合一项请求的情况下才获得,而一系列不同长度的请求则使较小的足迹稳步增加。

blocks.en: In the session of the repeat run, we also compared the compact engine with EMULV (Section 5 ) on the same two-GPU path: the prefill engine prefilled 8 needle prompts of 7,666 tokens one at a time, NIXL moved their KV caches, and the decode engine decoded each alone, 64 tokens with ignore_eos . The 512 output tokens were identical, the log-probabilities of the sampled tokens were bit-equal, and both engines gave the correct answer for 8 of 8 prompts. Only the first 4 to 6 tokens of each output are the answer; the rest are forced text that still tests the numerical identity.
blocks.zh: 在重复运行的会话中,我们还在同一双GPU路径上将紧凑引擎与EMULV(第5节)进行对比:预填引擎预装了8针提示,每次7,666个令牌,NIXL移动了他们的KV缓存,解码引擎各自解码,64个令牌被忽略_eos. 512的输出令牌完全相同,抽样的令牌的对数概率是比特均匀的,两个引擎都给出了8个提示中的8个正确答案. 每个输出中只有前4至6个符号是答案;其余是仍然测试数字身份的强制文本.

blocks.en: In the first D3H run, the NIXL lease of 35% to 42% of the requests expired before the decode engine read them, so these requests may have decoded with other KV values. This cannot change the count of decode tokens per step, and the repeat run, with a longer lease and no expired lease, repeated the compact value to 0.06% (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 在第一次D3H运行中,35%至42%请求的NIXL租赁在解码引擎读取前到期,因此这些请求可能已经与其他KV值解码. 这不能改变每步解码符的计数,重复运行,加上租期更长且没有到期的租借,将紧凑值重复到0.06%(附录E.

blocks.en: 7 Related work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en: Multi-query [ 17 ] and grouped-query attention [ 18 ] share keys and values across query heads, and cross-layer schemes share them across layers [ 19 , 20 ] . Multi-head latent attention [ 4 ] caches a compressed latent and a separate RoPE key, and its decode kernels [ 5 ] read the key and the value from one cached row. Grouped-tied attention [ 21 ] and grouped value attention [ 22 ] also keep one cached state with a separate RoPE part, but both are trained from scratch; MHA2MLA [ 23 ] and TransMLA [ 24 ] convert trained models to MLA with fine-tuning. The Gemma 4 report credits Kayyam et al. [ 25 ] for the reuse of keys as values in global layers. Our row has the shape of these designs, but it is an inference layout for released models that already tie the key to the value, with no training and no new kernel. The fold of w 𝒰 w_{\mathcal{U}} into the query is the absorption technique of MLA [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh: 多清流 [17] 和分组-清流注意 [18] 在查询头之间共享密钥和值,跨层方案在层间共享 [19, 20]. 多头潜在注意 [4] 缓存一个压缩的潜伏键和一个单独的 RoPE 密钥,其解码内核 [5] 从一个缓存行读取密钥和值. 分组式注意 [21] 和分组值注意 [22] 也保持一个缓存状态,其中单独的ROPE部分,但两者都是从零开始训练的; MHA2MLA [23] 和 TransMLA [24] 用微调将训练过的模型转换为MLA. Gemma 4号报告将重用键作为全球层值的Kayyam 等人[25]作为贷项。 我们的行有这些设计的形状,但对于已释放的模型来说是一种推论布局,它已经将密钥与值联系起来,没有训练,也没有新的内核. w w_{\mathcal{U}}] 折叠到查询中是 MLA [4] 的吸收技术.

blocks.en: Quantization [ 26 , 27 ] and token eviction [ 28 , 29 , 30 ] reduce the cache with some loss. LowRAM [ 31 ] predicts the values from the keys and stores residuals, which is near-lossless. Slim attention [ 6 ] stores only the keys and computes the values from them; it is exact in real arithmetic, but it needs an invertible key projection and extra compute. The Gemma 4 global layers are an elementwise case of such a relation, so the compact row needs no rebuild of the values. Kanwat [ 32 ] also folds a term into the keys so that unchanged vLLM kernels read a compacted cache.
blocks.zh: 量化[26,27]和象征性驱逐[28,29,30]减少缓存,并减少一些损失. LowRAM [31] 预测键的值,并存储残存,这几乎是无损失的. Slim attention [6] 只存储密钥并从中计算值;在真实的算术中是准确的,但它需要不可逆的密钥投影和额外计算. Gemma 4 全球层是这种关系的一个元素性案例,因此紧凑行不需要重建值. Kanwat [32] 还将一个术语折叠到密钥中,以使未修改的vLLM内核读取一个压缩缓存.

blocks.en: PagedAttention and vLLM [ 1 ] manage the cache in blocks, and Jenga [ 33 ] manages layers with different page sizes in vLLM; our page plan is a small case of that problem. Disaggregated serving moves the KV cache from prefill GPUs to decode GPUs [ 12 , 13 ] , and Mooncake [ 14 ] also keeps KV caches in CPU memory and SSDs. These systems change where the cache lives and when it moves; the compact row makes the cache of each request smaller, so it combines with them (Section 6 ). We read the KV-cache code of vLLM, SGLang [ 34 ] , TensorRT-LLM, Hugging Face transformers [ 35 ] and other code bases, and we searched 15 repositories, arXiv and the web (Appendix F ). In each code base, these layers write a full key and a full value, or the model conversion produces standard key and value heads. We found no code, issue or pull request that stores the Gemma 4 global KV cache once; a search cannot see private code.
blocks.zh: PagedAttention and vLLM [1] 以块管理缓存,Jenga [33] 在 vLLM 管理不同页面大小的层;我们的页面计划是这个问题的一个小例子. 分类服务将 KV 缓存从预填 GPU 移动到解码 GPU [12, 13], Mooncake [14] 还将 KV 缓存保存在 CPU 内存和 SSD 中. 这些系统会改变缓存的居住地点和移动时间;紧凑的行会让每个请求的缓存变小,从而与它们结合(第6节. 我们读了vLLM,SGLang [34],TensorRT-LLM,Hugging Face变压器[35]和其他代码基础的KV-cache代码,我们搜索了15个寄存器,arXiv和网络(Appendix F. 在每一个代码基中,这些层写一个完整的密钥和一个完整的值,或者模型转换产生标准密钥和值头. 我们没有发现任何代码, 发布或拉动请求, 可以存储 Gemma 4 全球 KV 缓存一次; 搜索无法看到私有代码 。

blocks.en: 8 Limitations
blocks.zh: 8 限制

blocks.en: • One model family and one vLLM build. All measurements use the 31B model, except the NIXL connector tests of Section 6.2 , which used the 12B model; the 26B-A4B model has none. The method needs this K=V structure, and such exact redundancy is rare. In 16 current model configurations that we read on 2026-11-10, every other exact redundancy of 10% or more that a model declares in its KV cache was already used by vLLM or by the serving image that the model supports. • The decode-node tests (Section 6 ) cover two operating points on one axis (the prompt length) at one pool size, one request sequence per point, eager mode, one cloud host per run and random-token prompts with fixed output lengths. Both point checks pass only because the frozen bands were widened by 1%: the engine was 0.7% to 0.9% above the range of the model. The error of the model differs by point and by layout, so we do not claim a constant bias. The throughput ratios are single runs, with a stock A/A spread of 2.7%. The NIXL patch is likely only a back-port for the pinned vLLM build, and the exactness check on this path used 8 prompts of one length at batch 1. • The engine tests used a 16-bit cache and only the Triton backend on an A100. The FP8 compact row and the FlashAttention-4 read have only kernel-level tests on an H100, and at the default FP8 KV scale of 1.0 the compact row fails our attention-error bound, so the saving by a factor of 1.34 to 1.40 applies only to a 16-bit cache. • Each test of Section 5 used one GPU, and the A100 ran under its power cap. Its capacity and timing runs used synthetic random-token prompts of equal length. We did not test prefix caching (the 48-token block changes the alignment of cache hits), tensor parallelism, speculative decoding or more than 16 concurrent sequences; Section 6 used mixed-length traffic, but only on one decode node. • The accuracy test covers final answers with greedy decoding; its longest prompt has 7.7K tokens, its margin of ± 3 \pm 3 points is a project heuristic, and its positive control did not separate from the compact arm. In our vLLM path, the instruct model scored raw natural text poorly in both checkpoints that we used (up to 10.5 nats per token on books); we did not find the cause or run a reference check with Hugging Face transformers, and all our model-level results use this path. Because both arms use the same path, a shared defect would not create a difference between them, but it could hide one. • For a fixed batch, the capacity gain is an integer effect of the pool size: at 64K tokens it gave no throughput gain in our pool. A stream of requests of mixed lengths gave a steady gain (Section 6 ). • The prototype applies its transforms at run time. The load-time folds and the default graph mode of vLLM (piecewise graphs with torch.compile ) were not tested, the CUDA-graph timing is exploratory, and we had no hardware counters for DRAM traffic.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: The global KV cache of Gemma 4 can be stored once, exactly in real arithmetic, as one 640-value row per KV head and token that unchanged attention kernels read through two views. In vLLM this cuts the steady decode KV memory per request by a factor of 1.34 to 1.40 at 32K to 64K tokens, and the final answers did not change beyond noise in our tests at contexts up to 7.7K tokens. The method is a memory mechanism: it adds requests per GPU where the KV pool is the limit. On a prefill/decode pair with NIXL transfer and CPU offload, it gave a decode engine with a full pool 1.38 and 1.24 times the decode tokens per step at two operating points, as a model of the block pool predicted, and 1.30 and 1.11 times the eager decode throughput. On this path its output matched its stock emulation for 8 prompts at batch 1. The run-time prototype costs 4% to 9% of an eager step at equal batch, and in an exploratory run with full decode CUDA graphs we saw no step cost above about 2%. We hope that serving engines adopt the layout for Gemma 4 and for future models that tie keys to values.
blocks.zh: Gemma 4的全球KV缓存可以存储一次,准确的算术,每KV头一个640个值行,和通过两个视图读取的不变关注内核的标志. 在vLLM中,这将每个请求的稳定解码KV内存切除系数为1.34到1.40,在32K到64K的令牌上,最后的答案在上下文中不超过7.7K令牌的测试中除了噪音没有变化. 该方法是一种内存机制:在KV池为极限的地方,每GPU会添加请求. 在预装/解码配对与NIXL传输和CPU卸载时,它给出了一个解码引擎,在两个操作点上每步解码符的1.38倍和1.24倍,作为区块池预测的模型,以及急切解码吞吐量的1.30倍和1.11倍. 在这条道路上,其产出与第1批8个提示的库存模拟相符。 运行时的原型在同等批量的急切步骤上花费了4%到9%,在一次带有全解码的CUDA图的探索性运行中,我们看到的步费没有超过约2%. 我们希望服务引擎采用Gemma 4的布局,以及未来将键与值挂钩的模型。

blocks.en: Each experiment had a written question and a decision rule that we froze in the project repository before the run. The design was reviewed before the run, and amendments came before the data of the run that they govern. For the GPU runs, a rehearsal with a smaller model or on a cheaper GPU ran first, and a review after the run recomputed the results. E-70 itself used the 12B model; E-72 and E-73 had no separate rehearsal, because they reused the code of E-71. Table 3 lists the experiments with the outcome that the frozen rule gave. The outcome words are those of each frozen rule. GO and PASS mean that the conditions of the rule held. PIVOT means that they held only in part, so the next step changed. BUILD-PIVOT (E-57) means that the outputs, the accuracy and the capacity passed, but the throughput gain held at one length only and the step cost was above its 5% limit. FAIL means that the result missed its bound. INVALID means that a validity check of the design failed; this does not mean that the data are wrong. We use numbers from INVALID runs only as exploratory results. The words of the decode-node tests (Section 6 ): CONNECTOR-WORKS, PATCH-WORKS and RELOAD-WORKS mean that the transfer and reload checks passed, and GAP-CONFIRMED that the unpatched connector failed as predicted; STEP-CONFIRMS means that R step R_{\text{step}} was inside the frozen band (CLEAN: with no expired NIXL lease); REPEATS means that a second run was within 0.5% of the first; SHIFT-MATCHES means that the change of R step R_{\text{step}} between two operating points was 0.75 to 1.25 times the predicted change; EXACT means identical output tokens. E-63, E-64 and E-67 are models that ran on a CPU. The main text names the decode-node runs by their role: the first D3H run is E-71, the repeat run is E-72, and the D3Q run is E-73. The main text writes “invalid” for the outcome INVALID.

blocks.en: In E-59 the output check required identical tokens from COMPACT and EMULV for 3 prompts. For one prompt the tokens differed from position 3, both with CUDA graphs and in eager mode. The compact cache leaves more blocks free, so the compact engine admitted that request one step earlier than the engine with the stock cache, and its prompt was split into other prefill chunks. The prompt is a random-token prompt, and STOCK and EMULV also differ on it (from position 4). A review of the run found the schedule difference sufficient to explain the failure; we did not show that it is the only cause. The two stock processes of E-59 differed by 1.1% in eager windows that we chose after the run; its frozen analysis, which included windows after a profiler pass, recorded 6.7%.
blocks.zh: 在E-59中,输出检查需要COMPACT和EMULV为3个提示提供相同的代号. 对于一个提示,符号与第3位不同,既有CUDA图,也有急切模式。 紧凑缓存留下了更多的块自由,因此紧凑引擎承认了这个请求,比拥有存量缓存的引擎提前一步,它的提示被分割成其他预填块. 提示是随机键的提示,STOCK和EMULV对此也有不同(来自位置4). 对运行情况的审查发现,时间表的差异足以解释失败;我们没有表明这是唯一的原因。 E-59的两个库存流程在运行后我们所选择的急切窗口中相差1.1%;其冷冻分析包括了配置器通过后的窗口,记录了6.7%.

blocks.zh: 附录B 准确性细节

blocks.en: The earlier accuracy run (E-56) emulated the compact arithmetic on the stock cache in the natural dimension order, so its sums run in a different order from the build. It used an automatic pool (92% of the GPU memory), at most 64 sequences and a maximum model length of 10,240 tokens; the build run used the 15 GiB pool, at most 16 sequences and 66,048 tokens. It had a noise arm, which adds one extra 16-bit rounding of the query, and a positive control, the stock 8-bit cache at a KV scale of 1.0. The accuracy change was − 0.46 -0.46 points ( [ − 1.24 , + 0.32 ] [-1.24,+0.32] ). Two of 432 final answers changed, against 3 for the noise arm; one item loops in the stock run and counts once in each compared arm, and without it the counts are 1 and 2. The mean negative log-likelihood of the reference solutions changed by − 0.0009 -0.0009 nats per token (interval [ − 0.0016 , − 0.0002 ] [-0.0016,-0.0002] ); the noise arm moved it by + 0.0027 +0.0027 , outside our margin of 0.002, and the sign of the compact shift is unexplained. The generated text differed in 21.5% of the items (noise arm: 17.4%). Over the needle-prompt tokens after position 1,024, the mean negative log-likelihood rose by + 0.0066 +0.0066 nats per token (interval [ + 0.0005 , + 0.0127 ] [+0.0005,+0.0127] ) under the emulated compact cache, by + 0.0074 +0.0074 under the noise arm and by + 0.0066 +0.0066 under the 8-bit control. But the baseline there is 11.04 nats per token, the poorly scored raw-text regime of Section 8 , so these numbers support no conclusion about the accuracy at long context.
blocks.zh: 早期的精度运行(E-56)在自然维度顺序中模仿了股票缓存上的紧凑算术,因此其总和运行顺序与积分不同. 它使用自动池(占GPU内存的92%),最多64个序列,最大模型长度为10,240个令牌;构建运行使用15个GiB池,最多16个序列和66,048个令牌. 它有一个噪声臂,它增加了一个额外的16位的查询四舍五入,以及一个正控,即以1.0的KV比例的股票8位缓存. 准确度变化为−0.46-0.46分([−1.24,+0.32] [1.24,+0.32]). 432个最后答案中有2个改变了,对噪声臂来说是3个;库存中有一个项目循环,每个比臂计算一次,没有它,计数是1和2. 参考溶液的平均负对数变化为−0.0009 - 0.0009纳特/每令牌(中间[−0.0016,−0.00002] [0.0016-000002]);噪音臂移动了+0.0027+0.0027,超出我们0.002的距离,而紧凑转变的信号是无法解释的。 生成的文字在21.5%的物品(噪音臂:17.4%)中有所不同。 在1 024 位置之后的针尖符号上,平均负对数每枚符号上升0.0066 + 0.0066 纳特(中间[+ 0.0005,+ 0.0127] [+ 0.0005,+ 0.0127])在模拟紧凑缓存下,上升+ 0.0074+ 0.074 在噪声臂下,并在8位控制下+0.0066+0.066. 但基准是每枚11.04纳特,即第8节中得分低的原始文字制度,因此这些数字不能支持对长上下文准确性的结论。

blocks.en: Appendix C Step-time details
blocks.zh: 附录C

blocks.en: The median slowdowns of the eager build run are 7.9% (32K) and 2.1% (64K): the step times are bimodal (20% to 32% of the steps are about 5 ms slower than the median), and the compact arm has a slightly heavier slow tail.
blocks.zh: 急切建设跑步的中位减速率为7.9%(32K)和2.1%(64K):步数为双向(20%至32%的步数比中位数慢约5ms),紧凑臂的慢尾略重.

blocks.en: A benchmark of the 10 global layers with synthetic caches and no model weights timed each part on its own, at the shapes of the engine runs. Read by the stock Triton kernel, the compact cache as built was 0.49 ms (32K) and 0.23 ms (64K) faster per 10-layer step than the stock cache, so the compact read does not explain the 3.7%. The transforms took 3.14 ms of CPU launch time per 10-layer step, but only 0.40 ms of GPU time inside a CUDA graph. In wall time they added 1.04 ms per 10-layer step, against 2.55 ms in the engine, so the benchmark explains about 40% of the engine cost. This agrees with a launch-time cost, but we did not test whether the eager engine step is bound by the CPU.
blocks.zh: 一个带有合成缓存且没有模型权重的10个全球层的基准,在引擎运行的形状上,每个部分单独定时. 由股票Triton内核读取,所构建的紧凑缓存每10层步骤的0.49 ms(32K)和0.23 ms(64K)比股票缓存更快,所以紧凑读取不解释3.7%. 变速器每10层台阶需要3.14 ms的CPU发射时间,但在一个CUDA图中只有0.40 ms的GPU时间. 在墙壁时间里,他们每10层台阶增加了1.04 ms,而发动机中则增加了2.55 ms,因此这个基准解释了大约40%的发动机成本. 这与发射时间成本一致,但我们没有测试急切的发动机步骤是否受CPU约束.

blocks.en: We then ran the 31B engine with full decode CUDA graphs (the FULL_DECODE_ONLY mode of vLLM, without torch.compile ), with the transforms attached before the graph capture (Figure 4 ). At 3 requests of 32K tokens, the compact step took 50.52 ms against 50.73 ms for the stock step (medians of 128-step windows; − 0.41 % -0.41\% ), and the transforms alone added 0.65%. The noise was 0.09% within a process and 0.13% between processes, so − 0.41 % -0.41\% is inside our 2% band and is not a speedup. A kernel profile agrees: the compact cache cut the attention kernel time by 0.49 ms per step, and the 110 transform kernels added 0.46 ms. The A100 lowers its clock when it reaches its power cap; the compact engines drew less power and ran at a 15 MHz higher clock. We count this as part of the effect of the method, not as a kernel gain. In the eager 128-step windows of the same run that the profiler did not touch (we chose them after the run), the transforms cost 4.8% again and the whole compact step 4.95%, against 8.7% in the first measurement. The cache-path cost did not appear there ( + 0.1 % +0.1\% ; two stock processes differed by 1.1%), so the cause of the 3.7% is not known.
blocks.zh: 然后我们运行了31B引擎,全解码为CUDA图形(fulL_DECODE_ONLY模式的vLLM,没有火炬.compile ),在图捕捉前附加了变换(图4). 在3个32K令牌的请求中,紧凑的步数为50.52 ms,对储量步数为50.73 ms(128 步窗口的介质;− 0.41%-0.41 \%),单变换就增加了0.65%. 声音在一个过程中为0.09%,在过程之间为0.13%,因此 - 0.41% - 0.41 \%在我们2%的波段内,不是速度。 一个内核剖面图同意:紧凑缓存将内核的注意力时间每步缩短0.49 ms,110变换内核增加了0.46 ms. A100在达到功率盖时会降低时钟;紧凑的发动机吸引的功率较少,运行时钟高15MHz. 我们把这算作方法效果的一部分,而不是内核增益. 在同一跑步器未触及的急切128步窗口中(我们在跑步后选择了它们),变速器再次耗资4.8%,整个紧凑的步数4.95%,而第一次测量为8.7%. 缓存路径成本没有出现在那里(+0.1%+0.1+%;两个库存流程差异为1.1%),因此3.7%的原因不明.

blocks.en: We label this run exploratory : its frozen output check failed for 1 of 3 prompts. A review of the run found that the compact engine, with more free blocks, admitted that request one step earlier and split its prompt into other prefill chunks; this is sufficient to explain the failure, but we did not show that it is the only cause. The check assumed equal schedules, so the run is INVALID by its own rule. The timing windows contain only full decode steps of all 3 requests, in every arm (Appendix A ). With full decode CUDA graphs we saw no step cost above about 2%; we do not claim zero cost.
blocks.zh: 我们标注这个运行探索 : 它的冻结输出检查失败了 。 对运行的回顾发现,拥有更多自由块的紧凑引擎提前一步接受了这个请求,并将其导出分解为其他预填块;这足以解释失败,但我们没有表明这是唯一的原因. 检查假设了相同的时间表,所以运行按自己的规则是INVALID. 计时窗口只包含所有3个请求的全解码步骤,在每个臂(Appendix A )中. 有了完全解码的 CUDA 图表,我们看到步骤成本没有超过2%左右;我们不声称零成本。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Change of the median decode step time against the stock engine in the same mode, at 3 requests of 32K tokens (31B, one A100). The gray band is ± 2 % \pm 2\% . Exploratory: the output check of this run failed, for a reason that we think lies outside the timing windows. We chose the eager 128-step windows after the run, from windows that the profiler did not touch; the compact and stock eager windows come from different engine processes (two stock processes differed by 1.1%), and within one process the spread was 0.09%.
blocks.zh: 图4:在3次请求32K令牌(31B,1A100)时,改变中位解码步骤时间与库存引擎的同一模式. 灰色的乐队是 ± 2%\pm 2\% 。 探索性:本次运行的输出检查失败,原因我们认为位于计时窗口之外. 我们在运行后选择了急切的128步窗口,从配置器没有触及的窗口中选择;紧凑和存量急切的窗口来自不同的引擎流程(两股流程相差1.1%),在一个流程中,分布率为0.09%.

blocks.en: Appendix D Kernel studies (exploratory)
blocks.zh: 附录D 核心研究(探索)

blocks.en: The H100 studies used one H100 80GB and the FP8 checkpoint of Appendix F , a different operating point from the A100 engine runs. The ceiling estimate of the decode-step saving (at the lower 95% bound of the time slope) was 6.65% at 32K and 11.33% at 64K tokens with a 16-bit KV cache at batch 4 (E-49), and 12.1% and 15.0% with an FP8 KV cache near the pool limit (E-50). These estimates assume that the attention time follows the bytes.
blocks.zh: H100研究使用了一个H100 80GB和附录F的FP8检查点,与A100发动机运行的操作点不同. 解码步骤保存的上限估计(时间坡度下限95%)是32K的6.65%,64K的标志为11.33%,第4批(E-49)有一个16位的 KV缓存,而池限(E-50)附近的FP8 KV缓存为12.1%和15.0%. 这些估计假设注意时间跟随字节.

blocks.en: The attention time does not follow the bytes: in three families of FP8 attention kernels for head size 512, the time elasticity to DRAM bytes was 0.16 to 0.24, so removing a fraction f f of the bytes removed only about 0.2 ​ f 0.2f of the time that grows with the context. The stock FlashAttention-4 [ 36 ] FP8 kernel of vLLM read the two views of an FP8 compact cache with no code change and with the same error as its normal input. It was 7% to 10% faster in the context-dependent time, which is about 3% of a decode step near the pool limit, and its measurements also ran at a 5.7% higher clock. These two kernel runs (E-51 and E-52) are INVALID by their frozen rules, so their numbers are exploratory. On the A100 (E-58), the compact row read in a 32-token block saved 6.6% (32K) and 3.5% (64K) of the read time, and the 48-token cache as built saved 9.7% and 2.7%. In rehearsal runs on GPUs with less bandwidth per unit of compute, the saving was larger: 28% to 37% of the read time on an A40 (the same benchmark) and 35% to 36% of the context-dependent kernel time on an RTX 4090. This suggests that the speed effect grows on such GPUs, but each value comes from one rehearsal, and these GPUs also differ in other ways.
blocks.zh: 注意时间不跟随字节:在头大小512的FP8注意内核的三个家族中,对DRAM字节的时间弹性为0.16至0.24,因此去除一个小节的fff只去除随着上下文生长的大约0.2f0.2f的时间. vLLM的股票FlashAtting-4 [36] FP8内核读取了一个FP8紧凑缓存的两个视图,没有代码更改,错误与其正常输入相同. 在上下文依赖的时间内,它的速度是7%到10%,这大约是池限附近解码步骤的3%,它的测量也运行在5.7%的时钟上. 这两条内核运行(E-51和E-52)根据其冻结规则是INVALID,因此其数量是探索性的. 在A100(E-58)上,以32个键块读取的紧凑行节省了读取时间的6.6%(32K)和3.5%(64K),而建成的48个键缓存节省了9.7%和2.7%。 在每计算单位带宽较少的GPU上进行排练时,节省量更大:在A40(同一基准)上,28%至37%的阅读时间,在RTX 4090上,35%至36%的内核依赖时间. 这表明速度效应会增长到这种GPU上,但每个值都来自一个排练,这些GPU在其他方面也有所不同.

blocks.en: We tested the compact row with an FP8 cache on real activations of the global layers, captured in vLLM on one H100. At the default KV scale of 1.0, the compact row failed our attention-error bound in one layer. With tied, calibrated per-layer scales, it had 0.67 times the attention error of the stock FP8 cache and 1.13 times the error of the best-calibrated standard FP8 cache, on 7 prompts. It needs scales with an error of at most 0.1% to 0.25%, and the stock FlashAttention-4 FP8 kernel read it in decode calls. The tied row has no model-level test, so we do not know whether it stacks with FP8 quantization.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个FP8缓存测试了紧凑的一行 全球层的真正激活, 在一个H100上的vLLM中捕获。 在默认的 KV 比例为 1.0 时, 紧凑的行失败了 我们的注意力- 错误绑在一层 。 用捆绑,校准的每层天平,它拥有0.67倍的股票FP8缓存的注意误差和1.13倍的最好校准的标准FP8缓存误差,在7个提示上. 它需要最大为0.1%至0.25%的错误的尺度,股票FlashAttention-4 FP8内核在解码调用中读取. 捆绑的行没有模型级测试,所以我们不知道它是否与FP8的四化堆积在一起.

blocks.en: Appendix E Decode-node details
blocks.zh: 附录 E 解码节点细节

blocks.en: We used the stock vLLM offload connector set to store all blocks ( offload_prompt_only off and prefix_cache_retention_interval unset; with the default retention of 0, a reload stopped at the end of the prompt in a 12B control). We forced preemptions of compact requests on the 31B model on one A100. The reloads restored the generated tokens (a median decode coverage of 0.977; stock 0.984), and 24 checked reloads (11,676 blocks) matched byte for byte, except blocks that vLLM had computed again after an earlier reload: the tier keeps the first stored copy of a block and does not store it again, so these came back as the first version. Loads ran at about 24 GB/s.
blocks.zh: 我们使用股票 vLLM 卸载连接器设置来存储所有块( 卸载_ prompt_ 仅关闭和前缀_ cache_ release_ interval unset; 默认保留 0, 重新装入在 12B 控制中提示的结尾停止) 。 我们强迫先发制人地在一台A100上的31B型机上提出压缩请求。 重新加载还原了生成的令牌(中位解码覆盖0.977;库存0.984),以及24个被检查的重新加载(11,676块)与字节匹配的字节(11,676块),但vLLM在之前重新加载后再次计算出来的块除外: 级保存了块的第一个存储副本,不再存储,因此这些是作为第一个版本回来的. 负载运行速度约为24GB/s.

blocks.en: The padded compact page does not divide the shared KV buffer into NIXL regions, so the connector of the pinned build refused the cache. Our patch registers a byte view of each padded page (a two-dimensional uint8 view at the same address). With the 12B model on two L40S, NIXL moved 8 prompts of 7,666 tokens from a prefill engine to a decode engine; all 3,192 full blocks matched, and the decode engine answered 8 of 8 correctly. With both connectors on one decode engine, forced preemptions reloaded NIXL-fed compact requests with their generated tokens (a median coverage of 0.953, 24 checked reloads of 9,192 blocks, with no mismatch other than the first-version effect).
blocks.zh: 添加紧凑的页面没有将共享的KV缓冲区划分为NIXL区域,因此被绑定的构建的连接器拒绝缓存. 我们的补丁记录每个加页的字节视图(在同一地址的二维的uint8视图)。 随着两个L40S上的12B型号,NIXL将7,666个令牌的8个提示从一个预填引擎移动到一个解码引擎;所有3,192个整块都匹配,解码引擎正确回答8中的8个. 两个连接器都安装在一个解码引擎上,强迫预置器用其生成的代号重新装入NIXL-feed压缩请求(中位覆盖范围为0.953,24个经检查的重装9,192块,除第一版效果外没有不匹配).

blocks.en: When the tier is full, the model evicts the request with the oldest rank, which is set at its first store and renewed when the request finishes. The model tier holds 200 GB and the engine tier 64 GiB; a check with a 64 GiB and a 10 GB tier gave the same predictions.
blocks.zh: 当层层满满时,模型以最古老的级别驱逐请求,该级别设置在它的第一商店,并在请求完成后续订. 模型级持有200GB,发动机级64 GiB;用64GiB和10GB级的检查给出了相同的预测.

blocks.en: At D3H the stock engine matched the model (5.458 against 5.454 decode tokens per work step), and the compact engine was 0.95% above it. At D3Q the compact engine matched (10.133 against 10.130), and the stock engine was 0.6% below. The engine also preempted more than the model (6 against 3 per arm at D3H; 12 and 16 against 8 and 9 at D3Q); we did not test whether this explains the difference.
blocks.zh: 在D3H时,库存引擎与车型(5.458对5.454的每个工作步骤解码符)相匹配,紧凑引擎比它高出0.95%. 在D3Q时,紧凑型发动机配对(10.133对10.130),库存发动机低于0.6%。 发动机还比型号先发制人(D3H时每臂6对3;D3Q时12和16对8和9);我们没有测试这是否解释了区别.

blocks.en: In E-71 the driver held prefilled requests outside the decode scheduler for up to a few minutes. The prefill engine keeps the blocks of a prefilled request for a lease of 30 s by default, and the decode engine extends the lease only for requests in its own scheduler. So 35% to 42% of the requests were read after the prefill engine had freed their blocks. The count of decode tokens per step does not depend on the KV values (the output lengths are fixed and prefix caching is off), and both layouts were affected alike. E-72 used a 600 s lease, and no lease expired. In E-72 the decode-engine logs also showed that the 8 exactness prompts came through NIXL and were not computed again.
blocks.zh: 在E-71中,司机在解码调度器外持有预填请求,最长可达几分钟. 预填引擎默认保留预填请求租赁30s的区块,解码引擎仅延长自身排程器中请求的租赁. 所以35%到42%的请求在预填引擎解冻后被读取. 每步解码符的计数不取决于KV值(输出长度固定,前缀凸起关闭),两种布局同样受到影响. E-72使用600s租赁,没有租赁到期. 在E-72中,解码引擎日志还显示,8个精确率提示通过NIXL,没有再次计算。

blocks.en: One A100 SXM 80GB, eager mode unless stated, a 16-bit KV cache, no prefix caching, seed 0 and at most 2,048 batched tokens per step. The build, capacity and step-time runs (E-57 to E-59): a fixed KV pool of 15 GiB (6,144 blocks), at most 16 sequences and a maximum model length of 66,048 tokens. The emulation run (E-56): an automatic pool (92% of the GPU memory), at most 64 sequences and a maximum model length of 10,240 tokens.

blocks.en: Modal containers (gVisor) with one A100-SXM4-80GB (E-69), two L40S (E-70) or two A100-SXM4-80GB (E-71 to E-73); the prefill and decode engines run in two processes on separate GPUs of one container. NIXL uses UCX with ucx_error_handling_mode set to none (the container has no TCP network devices, and the default mode refused the intra-node transports). The decode engine uses a MultiConnector of the NIXL connector and the offload connector ( cpu_bytes_to_use 64 GiB in E-71 to E-73, offload_prompt_only off, prefix_cache_retention_interval unset). E-71 to E-73: decode pool 15 GiB, at most 16 sequences and 2,048 batched tokens; prefill engine at most 4 sequences and 1,024 batched tokens; maximum model length 144,000 tokens on both; NIXL lease 30 s (the default) in E-71 and 600 s in E-72 and E-73. The request streams: prompt lengths lognormal with median 16,384 (D3H) or 8,192 (D3Q) tokens, clipped to 256 to 131,072; output lengths lognormal with median 2,048, clipped to 16 to 16,384; log-scale standard deviation 0.6; random number seed string 64-D3H-0 or 64-D3Q-0 ; requests whose stock reservation does not fit the empty pool, or whose prompt and output exceed the maximum model length, are skipped, in the model and in the engine alike.
blocks.zh: 具有一个A100-SXM4-80GB(E-69),两个L40S(E-70)或两个A100-SXM4-80GB(E-71至E-73)的Modal容器(gVisor);在一个容器的单独GPU上,预装和解码引擎分两个过程运行. NIXL使用UCX,其中ucx_error_loading_mode设置为无(容器没有TCP网络设备,默认模式拒绝节点内传输). 解码引擎使用NIXL连接器和卸载连接器的多连接器(cpu_bytes_to_use 64 GiB in E-71 to E-73,卸载_prompt_仅关闭,前缀_cache_relected_interval unset). E-71至E-73:解码池 15 GiB,最多16个序列和2,048个批次的令牌;预填引擎最多4个序列和1,024个批次的令牌;两者最高型号长度144,000个令牌;NIXL租赁30 s(默认)在E-71,600 s在E-72和E-73. 请求流:快速长度为对数正常,中间值为16,384(D3H)或8,192(D3Q),剪至256至131,072;输出长度为对数正常,中间值为2,048,剪至16,384;日志尺度标准偏差为0.6;随机数种子字符串64-D3H-0或64-D3Q-0;在模型和引擎中均跳过其股票预留不符合空池或其迅速和输出超过最大模型长度的请求。

blocks.en: We drew 400 problems from the GSM8K test split with seed 56. The user turn is “Solve the math problem. Show brief steps, then write the final answer as a number after ‘####’.” and the problem. The 32 needle prompts have 7,666 to 7,668 tokens: 7,600 tokens from one of 4 PG-19 test books, with the sentence “The secret passphrase for the archive is <word>-<4 digits>.” at 8 depths (5% to 89%), and the question “What is the secret passphrase for the archive? Answer with the passphrase only.” The prompts use the chat template of the checkpoint with thinking off. Decoding is greedy, with at most 640 tokens for GSM8K and 128 for the needles, and it stops at the end-of-turn token (id 106).
